seed: A Size measurement's number used to land 11 px off the edge it was measuring, whatever the label size. On a 2x screenshot that is five points of air under a twenty point pill, so the number read as part of the button rather than as a note about it, and that is the picture you hand to a developer. The number now stands off by half its own height, so it scales with the label-size slider instead of being a fixed eleven pixels. Stage one is the tight case: a shape jammed into the bottom-right corner of the picture, where there is no room to stand off into and the number has to stay whole and on the picture instead. Stage two measures a button with room around it, which is the case the fix is for. The shape is drawn before anything is measured so it does not inherit the measure ink.

steps.note: THE SETUP: a 200 x 140 shape jammed into the bottom-right corner of the picture, so neither number has anywhere clear to stand off into
THE FIRST CLAIM: with no room to stand off into, both numbers turn round to the free side and land whole and on the picture. A readable number beats a well-spaced one that is half off the image

THE SECOND CLAIM: the Save Changes button's width number stands clear below it and its height number stands clear to the right, with visible air and two readable legs, instead of both pills kissing the button
